evidence_items.explanation: The first incremental successor reports fewer false statements than the October-generation Claude 2.0 on the company's factual-question evaluation. This directly supports mitigation of an existing weakness, within that evaluation's scope.

The major successor release compares Sonnet directly with Claude 2 and 2.1. The release also documents broader capabilities, vision input and improved instruction following, supporting the predicted capability increase.

The release documents deployed tool-enabled tutoring, progress tracking and course navigation, alongside browser-data extraction and multi-step customer workflows. These reported deployments supply the practical-application component beyond the earlier capability and error-reduction evidence.
